prompt: When trees develop leaves in the spring, 10 changes occur on the forest floor. Why does the development of leaves cause changes on the forest floor? (A) Rainfall increases. (B) Sunlight is reduced. (C) Wind speed increases. (D) Animal migration is stopped.
response: The development of leaves in the spring causes changes on the forest floor primarily because it increases rainfall. As leaves grow, they alter the local climate, leading to more precipitation, which affects the forest floor.
